column1: # The Tlib3 oPool itself is a synthesised library, not a single sequence, and is NOT here —
# which is part of what this run is testing.
# Tlib3 is an OLIGOPOOL, not one sequence. This row is its STENCIL: the conserved frame with
# the variable span written as a plain run of N at the pool's MEAN length, which is what the
# simulator eats without being taught anything. span= and n= say what is true of the pool.
